intro: We've gone digging deep into our archives today, vikings! We found some old stuff that you will recognize already (but we're putting it all here anyway so no one misses it), but we also found something that's been gathering dust for ages, perhaps even since the 90s! We made sure to digitize the old cassette for you, for your convenience.

lines.text: New build piece: Rock (it’s a friend!)
New game mode: Haldor (become the best merchant ever)
New weapon: Shotgun (extra damage against deer)
New weapon: Deer Raiser (raise mighty deer to fight for you)
New body type: Deer (when playing as a deer, other deer will not become frightened of you)
